forecast_seconds.basis: Same P19 single-node environment: admitted BF16 CCL diagnostic completed81.814s against60–600s forecast. That task had two reduced layers and40 reduction variants; this task has one reduced layer and four/five SDPA variants, so this is a broad sizing proxy only, not an apples-to-apples prediction.

serial_gates: Require no active local device owner and fresh device health/available-memory check.
Do not launch while Sklearn full-TT conditional job or other TT work owns the device.
No HF process or unrelated TT process may overlap.
Timeout1200s and the latest root deadline must both fit before admission.

runtime_contract.device: one local 4-chip mesh shape (1,4); code configures FABRIC_1D_RING
runtime_contract.input: first1024 tokenizer IDs from exact compressed natural-book file; tokenizer revision pinned in autoport weights module

interpretation_limits: Q128/K32 versus Q32/K32 compares identical full rotated Q and identical captured K/V cache at the same absolute origin; this isolates Q partition size for that input.
Full Q32 versus the 32:288 slice at absolute offset32 compares full and resumed query forms while holding Q values/cache/page table and Q32/K32 sizes fixed.

The 1024-token natural-book run uses real P19 weights and real model-generated Q/K/V, but is not the source failing SWE prefix, does not run the full 60-layer model, and cannot establish a full-model P19 cause or fix.
The stage capture found first nonexact differences at attention input on starts32/64 while QKV was exact; that makes this a discriminating local probe, not proof of cause.
